case.title: Board View's minimap scrolls the board, and no sideways scroll bar shows
case.refs: SV-11466,SV-10046 (S3-E2 scroll bar 16px / handle at least 150px - spec v66)
case.custom_preconds:
Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes · no new records

  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on staging or a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Browser zoom 100%, window full screen and at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • Location A: a location with more technicians than fit across the screen, so the last technician columns are off the right edge in Board View (e.g. on staging "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"; on a QA branch any location where Board View is wider than the window — if none is, add active technicians with Time Clock on in Settings > Staff until it is).
  • Location B: a location where every technician column fits on the screen (e.g. on staging "DVI Test", 8 technicians; on a QA branch a location with only 1 or 2 technicians).
  • To change location: click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
case.custom_steps:
1. At location A, click Work Orders in the top menu, then the All tab on the left of the toolbar. At the right of the toolbar click Board View (the right-most view button, tooltip "Board View"). Look under the technician columns at the bottom of the board, and at the bottom right corner of the screen.
  2. Count the small tiles in the minimap and compare them with the technician columns on the board.
  3. Scroll down inside the "Unassigned" column and look at the thin scroll bar inside that column.
  4. Drag the minimap's highlighted box (the thumb) all the way to the right, then all the way back to the left.
  5. Click the last tile in the minimap.
  6. Click the first tile in the minimap. With the minimap still focused, press the Right arrow twice, then the Left arrow once, then End, then Home.
  7. Move the mouse over the board and scroll sideways with a trackpad, or hold Shift and turn the mouse wheel.
  8. Look at the chat bubble at the bottom right of the screen.
  9. Change to location B and open Work Orders > All > Board View again. Look at the bottom right corner of the screen.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no sideways scroll bar under the board. The minimap shows, fixed at the bottom right of the screen, without needing to scroll first.
  • Step 2: there is one tile for each technician column, in the same order as the board. "Unassigned" has no tile, and it stays on screen at the left.
  • Step 3: the column's own thin scroll bar works as before.
  • Step 4: the board follows the thumb: dragging right reaches the last technician column, dragging left comes back to the first. The thumb always sits over the columns that are on the screen.
  • Step 5: the board scrolls to the last technician's column.
  • Step 6: the first tile scrolls to the first technician's column; each Right arrow moves the board one column right, Left moves it one column back, End goes to the last column and Home to the first.
  • Step 7: the board scrolls sideways.
  • Step 8: the chat bubble sits above the minimap and does not cover it.
  • Step 9: every column fits, and there is no minimap and no sideways scroll bar.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); fast-follow ticket SV-11835 (Chris Ward on SV-11835, 27 Oct 2026: the minimap and the removed sideways scroll bar come in the same change, PRD v80)

  • S3-E2: “Allow horizontal scrolling when technician columns exceed the available viewport; never hide technicians automatically. The board shows no sideways scrollbar, in any browser; it scrolls sideways with the minimap (S3-E2a), a trackpad, or Shift with the mouse wheel. The scrollbars inside each column are unchanged.”
  • S3-E2a: “When the technician columns are wider than the screen, Board View shows the design’s minimap, fixed at the bottom right: one tile per technician column in board order (Unassigned, which is always on screen, has none) and a thumb over the columns currently in view. It shows whenever the board is wider than the screen, not only while it scrolls, and hides when every column fits. Dragging the thumb scrolls the board; clicking a tile scrolls to that column; with the minimap focused, Left and Right arrows move one column and Home and End go to the first and last. The minimap is at most 360px wide or 40% of the screen width, whichever is smaller; at a location with many technicians the tiles shrink so every column still has one. While it shows, the chat launcher at the bottom right moves up so it never covers the minimap, as on the work order page. Screen readers announce it as "Board columns" with "Columns {first} to {last} of {total}".”

The minimap's size, the many-technician board and the screen-reader words are checked in their own test.

Last checked against build v26.43.2-5edf9c2 on 10/28/2026 (QA branch sv11835).
